pages.useful_because: The homepage tells a San Marcos homeowner or business owner exactly what Coastal Trim Lighting does and how to get it booked: the three services it offers (holiday lighting for homes, holiday lighting for businesses and commercial properties, and permanent landscape and outdoor lighting), who owns it (Jacob Akbari), where it is based (1326 Topanga Drive, San Marcos, CA 92069), how long it has operated (since 2016) and roughly how far it travels (about 25 miles). Its comparison table separates the seasonal holiday services from the year-round landscape install and lists what to have ready for each, so the first call can be priced, and the FAQ answers price, property type, off-season work, service area and scheduling from intake facts only.
